scan_linter_check.description:
Flags setBasicAuth() calls whose password is not a string literal (literal passwords are reported by SEC-001 at priority 1). Credentials handled in script are easy to log or leak and cannot be rotated without touching code. Deactivate this check if your standard allows setBasicAuth() with credentials read from a secure store.
Replaces the legacy check "NS: Avoid using setBasicAuth for REST messages".
scan_linter_check.name: SEC-004: Credentials set in script with setBasicAuth()
scan_linter_check.resolution_details: Configure a Basic Auth profile on the REST Message, or a Connection & Credential alias, and use setAuthenticationProfile() instead of passing credentials in script.
scan_linter_check.short_description: A REST or SOAP message gets its credentials from script through setBasicAuth().
scan_linter_check.sys_name: SEC-004: Credentials set in script with setBasicAuth()
